title: Unified Data, Unified Insights: Meet the Graph Lakehouse
by: Weimo Liu and Jaz Ku (PuppyGraph) and Robert Pack (Databricks), Open Lakehouse + AI
summary: A 50-minute live session from the Delta Lake community with demos of querying Delta Lake tables as a graph with PuppyGraph, running multi-hop Cypher and Gremlin queries, and visualising the results, without a separate graph database or copy pipeline. Summarised here from the event description and listing; two of the three speakers are from PuppyGraph.
